title: directives
description: The strategist's plan as machine-readable instructions for an executor (docs/PROTOCOL.md, Directives). Every field is optional; an executor uses its own default for anything missing.

day.description: The day the directives were written for.

wholesale_max_pct.description: Accept a wholesale lot up to this % of its estimate.

single_max_pct.description: Accept a single lot up to this % of its estimate.

stock_cap.description: gym executor: stop buying above this stock value

min_pct.description: Sell at no less than this % of the estimate.

sell_down_to_cash.description: Sell stock until cash reaches this (e.g. before rent).

sell_hot.description: gym executor: stage stolen goods for sale (default false: hold until heat 0)

services.description: Service ids to have on tonight.

upgrades_buy.description: Upgrade ids to buy tonight, in order.

scavenge.description: Go to the dumping ground tonight.

engine.description: gym executor: which production engines to run, joined by +

mortgage.description: gym executor: sign the loan shark's offer by the rule (auto), at the next offer (take), not today (later; he returns next week), never again (decline is final), or to bridge a rent the cash cannot pay

buyout_by_day.description: gym executor: answer the loan shark later while the cash buyout projects to be affordable by this day

mortgage_margin.description: gym executor: auto signs when the projected cover reaches this share of the total payments

mortgage_float.description: gym executor: cash beyond 1.5 payments that auto keeps after the down payment

mortgage_window.description: gym executor: the game days [from, to] on which auto or take may sign

mortgage_save_from_day.description: gym executor: from this day, stop buying and save toward the offer threshold

appraisal.description: gym executor: join the appraisal board and serve its clients, or not

mortgage_max_spend.description: gym executor: daily cap on trading purchases while paying the mortgage

buyout_save.description: gym executor: spending cut while saving for the cash buyout, from buyout_save_from

buyout_save_from.description: gym executor: the day buyout_save starts

fountain.description: gym executor: buy Wild's water fountain, or take the landlord's (+150 weekly rent)

bargain_buy.description: gym executor: haggling with sellers (bargain is with buyers)

speculate.description: gym executor: hold goods of these types from ordinary buyers until a market event or an Upper Levels buyer with tips, or max_days

bays.description: best-graded water in the bays, never a worse grade on a better one, nutrient tablets to the plant's mineral band (default true)

bottles.description: tested High Quality or Pure water in the wine bottles before rations (default true)

quality.description: gym executor: the best grade the equipment allows (docs/research/QUALITY.md)

reeds.description: hydroreed bays curing water for the bays, bottles and the water trade (default 1)

reeds_max.description: more reed bays once grow_cash is in hand

grow_cash.description: cash that adds the reeds_max bays (default 2500)

tap.description: rust: both taps (filtered rust is HQ by night 6); gutter: the gutter tap only; none: the reed cures bought water (default rust)

from_day.description: first day the taps and power kit may be bought (default 44, after Georgio's loan)

reserve.description: cash kept over the rent when a tap or power upgrade is bought (default 1000)

reed_after.description: bloomberry bays planted before a cellar's bay becomes a reed (default 1)

cure.description: decant once plant-safe (a cellar's default) or once a strip reads High Quality (a water route's)

store_l.description: litres of jugs and tanks kept to decant into (24 for a cellar, 0 for a water route)

tank_l.description: scrap metal grows the reed's tank to this many litres (default 20)

bottles.description: empty wine bottles kept while the cured water covers them (default 8)

treat.description: the filter and tablet pipeline makes Basewater beside the reeds (default true)

power.description: a recharger and POWER_HIJACK for the bays' cells (default false)

commercial_power.description: with power, COMMERCIAL_POWER once four bays stand (default false)

showcase.description: a water route shows tested HQ water worth 350 for the water stockpiler (default true)

clean_water.description: gym executor: the staged clean-water build, taps then hydroreed bays (docs/research/QUALITY.md)

specialty.description: gym executor: buy only goods of these types (a lot when they are lot_share of its estimate)

arms.description: gym executor: the arms engine (docs/re/ARMS.md): weapon permits on display for gun-order clients, orders filled from stock with mods and repairs, permits II and III bought near their Security gates, guns held and printed for orders; `forge` builds them from printed frames finished New (a new printer with the metal and CNC modules)

breeding.description: gym executor: gene lines bred on the DNA manipulator (docs/research/BREEDING.md), off when absent; needs the wine engine (bays) and buys PLANT_DNA

lines.description: in priority order: a preset name, or {crop, edits, bank, min_success, give_up} (optionally {preset, ...} to override a preset)

crop.description: seed id, e.g. fillerweed_seed, coffee_bean, bloomberry_seed

edits.description: trait ids, one rank each, applied in order

bank.description: negative-complexity traits applied first when the next edit's odds are under min_success

give_up.description: bloomberry: stop editing a seed when the next op's odds fall below this

reserve.description: cash kept over rent and floor when buying PLANT_DNA

press.description: press produce whose only liquid is caffeine into caffeine pills with the lab's blender and finisher (default true with lab on)

press_min_ml.description: caffeine (ml, after the blender's loss) a press waits for

hold.description: caffeine produce held for the press; beyond it the produce sells raw

stolen.description: gym executor: the stolen-goods trade (docs/re/STOLEN.md): legal goods staged from a seller's mixed lot, stolen lots judged at their clean estimate, warm goods sold under a trafficking cap, no bargaining with Black Market sellers

power.description: gym executor: free power (sim/gym/Power.cs, docs/research/CHEMISTRY-ENGINE.md), off when absent

buy.description: auto: POWER_HIJACK and a recharger once they pay back within payback_weeks against bought cells

unit_price.description: what a unit of charge costs as bought cells

commercial.description: COMMERCIAL_POWER once the draw passes the rechargers' capacity

loose.description: charged cells kept loose for the engines

lab.description: gym executor: the chemistry lab (docs/research/CHEMISTRY-ENGINE.md), off when absent. "caffeine" is the older form of {products: ["caffeine_pill"]}

products.description: what to make, in priority order

modules.description: chem modules (Dr. Jackson's): when the gain pays back within payback_weeks, never, or up to four in the finisher and four in the blender

jackson_need.description: nights between trips to Dr. Jackson while a module is wanted; 0 never

inputs.description: beans or caps a batch at most

reserve.description: cash kept over rent and floor when buying the Retired Chemist

sell.description: stage our own dust and Phanta for buyers

cartel.description: the Chemist start's way out of the cartel (docs/research/CHEMISTRY-ENGINE.md, "The Cook gets out"): dried batches banked as residue and pressed on the weekly visit's morning, blanks set the mean purity

bank.description: bank dried dust batches unpressed until the visit (default true)

reserve_weeks.description: visits whose share the bank keeps (default 2)

unit_value.description: rep a bank unit above the reserve is worth (default 0.25)

reserve_value.description: rep a bank unit inside the reserve is worth (default 3)

extra_max.description: units over the count at most (default 40)

materials.description: the check-in's materials: when short of the next visit (default), always, never

caps_max.description: dream caps held at most (default 10): past the smuggler's bay an inspection seizes them

blender_first.description: chem modules into the blender first, up to this many (default 2)

after_exit.description: what the lab makes once the cartel is left (default nothing)

alcohol_ratio.description: alcohol : coffee mush (0.75 is the full yield)

recover.description: buy the solvent-recovery module, extract below 78 °C and dry in the evaporator to get half the alcohol back

alcohol_weeks.description: weeks of alcohol held in packs

hold.description: inputs held from sale and bought (default two batches)

window.description: the display case goes MEDICAL once our pills there reach 350

chem_bay.description: buy the chemist's storage bay when the stock grid is short and keep the kit in it

bath.description: one alcohol bath per batch fed in increments (the solvent is never consumed)

dry.description: where a batch is dried: evaporator with the recovery module (alcohol back) or a modded plate

bath_days.description: days a bath waits for more inputs before it is filtered and dried

wait_kotton_days.description: mornings a batch waits for kotton before it is filtered through water filters alone

caffeine_inputs.description: bred produce carrying the caffeine Production trait, pressed like coffee beans
